title: Ledger
description: Stage S4: how one chapter changes the state of the story or the argument. work/<guide>/ledger/<chapter-id>.json

chapter.description: Chapter id, as in the Map file: "ch3", "prologue"

Anchor.description: Where a fact is in the extracted text. Working files only: a guide never shows the quote.

file.description: The text file's number in toc.json, three digits: "005"

p.description: First and last paragraph, the [pN] marks of the text file: [11, 11] or [11, 14]

quote.description: 3 to 12 words copied exactly from the anchored paragraphs, so a script can confirm the anchor

Entry.description: Fiction: dimension, entity (not for time and place), after, and before when it was known. Non-fiction: status and text.

dimension.description: Fiction: what changes. time and place of the story; present = who is there at the end; goal, relation, knowledge, possession, view, state of a person

about.description: Fiction: the other person or thing, for relation, view, knowledge

before.description: Fiction: the state before; null when none was known

after.description: Fiction: the state at the chapter's end

cause.description: Fiction: why it changed, as the book shows it

text.description: Non-fiction: what is established, open, answered or promised
